title: Adversarial router certification
root_cause: Current routing has no fixed adversarial corpus measuring ambiguity, negative intent, alias/supersession, and stale/duplicate behavior.
source_requirement: Certify the migrated router with precision@1/3/5, must-not-return, and deterministic tie metrics.
implementation_steps: Author required ambiguity and negative-intent cases.
Define metric thresholds and deterministic tie rule.
Persist per-case outcomes and aggregate metrics.
negative_cases: Disk growth confused with personal growth.
Process debugging confused with n8n/Supabase debugging.
AI memory confused with database storage.
Model state confused with product model.
affected_tests: Semantic index and router unit tests.
evidence_required: Exact corpus hash, index revision, per-case results, and precision/must-not-return metrics.
rollback: Remove only the new corpus/certification projection; retain repaired router behavior.
